About the job

ZPI is the software division of ProMach, a leading provider of packaging
solutions. ZPI develops, implements, and supports digital intelligence software
systems that enhance the performance of packaged goods manufacturing
operations. With a strong foundation in production monitoring, ZPI is now
expanding into cloud-native products designed for the next generation of
manufacturing customers.

We're looking for a Cloud Architect & Engineer to lead the technical design and
implementation of our cloud-based products. You'll have significant influence
over how our products are structured, built, and deployed, working alongside
our engineering team to turn ideas into production-ready products. This is a
hands-on role: you'll design the system, build it, and own it in production.

What You'll Do

Architecture & Design

- Design cloud architecture for scalable, multi-tenant SaaS products from data
  ingestion through cloud-hosted services and customer-facing reporting.
- Define infrastructure patterns for multi-tenancy, data isolation, scalability,
  and security that hold up as the product grows.
- Evaluate technology and platform options with an eye toward long-term
  maintainability.
- Document architectural decisions and the reasoning behind them so the team
  inherits a clear, defensible record.

Cloud Engineering

- Build, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure and backend components
  alongside the engineering team.
- Design and build data pipelines that move operational data from customer
  environments into the cloud reliably, securely, and at scale.
- Contribute working knowledge of CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and cloud
  operational practices, getting pipelines stood up and knowing what good looks
  like.
- Establish monitoring, observability, and reliability practices that keep the
  product healthy in production.

What We're Looking For

- Proven experience designing and building cloud-native systems end-to-end, not
  just contributing to a single layer.
- Experience building systems that ingest and process high volumes of
  operational data reliably and at scale.
- Experience designing and deploying databases at scale, including schema
  design, query performance, and storage tradeoffs.
- Strong grasp of distributed systems: data flow, service boundaries, failure
  modes, and resilience patterns.
- Experience integrating cloud platforms with on-premises or operationally
  constrained environments.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure and the broader Microsoft technology
  ecosystem, including .NET and SQL Server; comfort with cloud-agnostic design
  principles a plus.
- Background in industrial, IoT, or manufacturing environments is a plus.
- Familiarity with SaaS architecture patterns: multi-tenancy, customer data
  isolation, subscription-based delivery.
- Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical and
  non-technical stakeholders.
- Comfortable operating with ambiguity and able to make sound decisions before
  everything is fully defined.
